question: Which host capabilities may a first-vertical WebAssembly component request?
selected_option: Pure typed proposal I/O: pass one immutable revision-bound invocation envelope into the component and accept one bounded proposal, diagnostic, or evidence result, exposing only structured logging and cancellation observation as host imports.
rationale: The user explicitly selected OPT-WASM-CAP-PURE-PROPOSAL. This gives first-vertical components a useful deterministic transformation boundary without workspace discovery, tool loops, direct effects, or ambient host access. Richer supervised agent behavior remains in the separate native agent host.

required_semantics: each invocation supplies one immutable envelope bound to workspace, artifact, source revision, component digest, WIT version, capability-profile identity, and invocation identity
the envelope contains all authorized context; the component cannot discover or request additional workspace state during execution
the component returns exactly one bounded typed result classified as proposal, diagnostic, evidence, or explicit failure
proposal content never becomes accepted prose until the native daemon validates it and a Work Owner performs the applicable acceptance action
the only host imports are bounded structured logging and read-only cancellation observation
structured logs are diagnostic evidence, are size- and rate-bounded, and cannot carry semantic output or secrets
cancellation, fuel exhaustion, deadline expiry, trap, malformed result, excess output, or host failure yields no partial result and no accepted-state mutation

no filesystem, database, network, HTTP, socket, environment, argument, standard-I/O, clock, randomness, secret, credential, process, browser, tool-request, publication, or external-effect capability is linked
the native agent host and browser supervisor remain separate, capability-gated systems
non_implications: pure proposal I/O does not make component output correct, accepted, trusted, or authoritative
structured logging is not a general standard-output channel
the selected profile does not authorize a component to request or execute agent tools, browser actions, network calls, file reads, file writes, or publication
this selection does not satisfy its Essays security-owner gate or select numeric limits, component identity, signing, provenance, cache, or distribution rules
this selection does not authorize implementation, dependency installation, component execution, release, or deployment

remaining_blockers: Essays security-owner review of the pure-proposal WebAssembly capability profile
WebAssembly numeric resource budgets and cancellation thresholds
WebAssembly component identity, signing, provenance, cache, and evidence rules
Essays security-owner review of the remote authentication binding
remote capability authorization and grant semantics
Product Capability decision and dependent contracts
authored ontology closure and DomainSpec generation
deferred_decisions: Revision-bound mediated reads and tool-request envelopes require later capability-profile candidates and new owner/security decisions.
